pageProps.title: Daily Briefing
pageProps.review: LLM, 파운데이션 모델, AI 연구 논문 등 AI 분야 핵심 소식을 큐레이팅한 2026년 6월 25일자 인사이트 리포트입니다.

pages.title: Bringing more control over your connectors
pages.what_its_about: Mistral AI has significantly strengthened connector security and control functions, such as workspace-specific control, connector scope API keys, and multi-account connectors, for safe integration with external corporate platforms.
key_points: Enhanced admin controls are available to set connector access at the workspace and organization level and control enable/disable on a per-tool basis.
Supports connector-scoped API keys to prevent impersonation when interacting with third-party systems in automated AI tasks.
Added Connector functionality in Vibe Code to enable connector reuse in the developer interface, and a Connector Debugger for analyzing MCP connectors.
pages.intended_audience: Corporate system administrators and developers who need external data integration security and management

pages.title: Workflows for work that runs the business
pages.what_its_about: Mistral AI has launched 'Workflows', an orchestration layer that supports stable operation and automation of enterprise AI processes, as a public pilot service.
key_points: Workflows provide the durability, observability, and fault tolerance to reliably transition AI processes from proof-of-concept to production.
Once developers write a workflow in Python, they can publish it to Le Chat so anyone in the organization can run it, and every step can be tracked and audited through Studio.
It has features such as overcoming timeouts due to Internet connection loss, etc., cost-free waiting through a single line 'wait_for_input()', and adding a real-time human approval step.
pages.intended_audience: Enterprise developers and operations teams looking to reliably automate and orchestrate AI-based business processes in production environments

pages.title: Introducing Forge
pages.what_its_about: Mistral AI has launched 'Forge', a system that helps companies build customized frontier-level AI models by learning their unique knowledge.
key_points: Forge learns internal knowledge about your company, including its engineering standards, compliance policies, and codebase, allowing you to create enterprise-specific AI models.
Supports modern training methods across the model lifecycle, including pre-training, post-training, and reinforcement learning.
This allows companies to maintain full control of their models, data, and long-term intellectual property while maintaining security and compliance even in regulated environments.
notable_data_or_quotes: Home Team Science and Technology Agency (HTX) Singapore
pages.intended_audience: Enterprise companies and developers who want to build custom AI models and agents while complying with their own data and security regulations

pages.title: Mistral AI partners with NVIDIA to accelerate open frontier models
pages.what_its_about: Mistral AI participates as a founding member of NVIDIA's Nemotron Alliance to jointly develop open frontier AI models and revitalize the developer ecosystem.
key_points: Mistral AI is a founding member of the NVIDIA Nemotron Alliance, combining its model architecture and learning technology with NVIDIA's compute resources and synthetic data pipelines.
The two companies will jointly develop a base model learned on NVIDIA DGX Cloud, which will become the basis for the NVIDIA Nemotron 4 model family that will be released as open source in the future.
As part of this partnership, Mistral AI has launched the Mistral Small 4 model to support developers and researchers around the world.
notable_data_or_quotes: “Open frontier models are how AI becomes a true platform,” said Arthur Mensch, cofounder and CEO of Mistral AI.
pages.intended_audience: AI developer, researcher, and enterprise technology stack decision maker

pages.title: Leanstral: Open-Source foundation for trustworthy vibe-coding
pages.what_its_about: Mistral AI has released Leanstral, the first open source code agent for Lean 4 proofreading.
key_points: To overcome the verification limitations of AI code generation models, we released a Leanstral agent capable of Lean 4 formal verification and proof.
Leanstral is designed as a highly sparse architecture with 6B activation parameters out of 120B total parameters, ensuring both efficiency and performance.
Weights are released under the Apache 2.0 license and provide free API endpoint and MCP (particularly lean-lsp-mcp) support.
pages.intended_audience: Software formal verification engineers, mathematical researchers, AI developers, and agent designers

pages.title: The Ultimate Summer Sale Pairing: Steam Sale Meets GeForce NOW Discounts
pages.what_its_about: There is news that NVIDIA is offering GeForce NOW membership discounts and supporting new game streaming during the Steam summer sale period.
key_points: The Steam Summer Sale and GeForce NOW's 12-month membership discount promotion are running simultaneously.
GeForce NOW Ultimate membership is available for $70 off, and Performance membership is available for $35 off.
Six new games were added to the GeForce NOW library this week, including the new Dark Scrolls from Devolver Digital.
pages.intended_audience: Consumers and gamers interested in cloud gaming and PC gaming

pages.title: Creating a security agent with Cohere North and Wiz
pages.what_its_about: A case of building a security agent that automates incident response workflow by linking Cohere North, Cohere's enterprise AI agent platform, and Wiz, a cloud security platform, with an MCP server.
key_points: We developed a security agent that automatically processes everything from incident investigation to ticket creation and report writing by connecting Cohere North with the Wiz GraphQL API through a custom MCP server.
The lightweight Python MCP server organizes Wiz's functions into eight independent tools (APIs) that North agents can call.
The analysis and investigation process, which took 30 minutes to 2 hours per case when security engineers responded manually, was shortened to about 20 seconds.
pages.intended_audience: Cloud Security Engineer, DevSecOps Developer, Enterprise Security Administrator

pages.title: The math behind the OpenAI Jalapeño chip
pages.what_its_about: This is about OpenAI collaborating with Broadcom to develop its own AI chip, 'Jalapeño', to reduce infrastructure costs and optimize LLM inference.
key_points: OpenAI developed the Jalapeño chip, a custom ASIC, to reduce dependence on Nvidia and control spiraling infrastructure costs.
This chip is designed specifically for LLM inference rather than general AI tasks, minimizing data movement bottlenecks and maximizing efficiency.
By introducing our own chips, we aim to create a virtuous cycle of cost reduction and product improvement by achieving vertical integration from chip architecture to application layer.
pages.intended_audience: Industry workers and IT experts interested in AI hardware trends, semiconductor and cloud infrastructure business

pages.title: There’s a very real human problem at the heart of the AI revolution
pages.what_its_about: It points out that the introduction of artificial intelligence (AI) does not lead to actual corporate financial performance or organizational transformation, and that the cause lies in human and process issues.
key_points: Many companies are adopting AI and investing huge amounts of money, but the actual impact on measurable profit and loss (P&L) is minimal.

Afrozy Ara, CEO of LuminaData, emphasizes the need to distinguish between ‘AI adoption’ and ‘AI transformation’ and the importance of making AI work effectively within complex organizational structures and processes.
There is a huge gap between improving productivity through tool use at the individual level and creating systematic value at the corporate level.
notable_data_or_quotes: $675 billion in infrastructure investment this year alone
According to KPMG, 93% of U.S. companies plan to deploy AI in finance in the next 18 months
MIT research shows 95% of enterprise AI pilots have zero measurable P&L impact
According to Cambridge's 2026 Global AI in Financial Services report, 81% of companies are adopting AI, but only 14% consider it transformational.
“ AI adoption is not AI transformation ”
pages.intended_audience: Corporate executives, IT and AI adoption strategy personnel, business analysts
pages.content_notes: The main text is cut off in the middle, so the conclusion ends somewhat incompletely.

pages.title: 10 best contract management software tools for 2026 (compared)
pages.what_its_about: This article compares and analyzes the features, pros and cons of the 10 best contract management software that provides AI-based review, search, and renewal management functions as of 2026.
key_points: The key differentiator for contract management software in 2026 will be how well AI reads and categorizes existing contracts and detects risks.
Gatekeeper leverages LuminIQ AI to manage contract reviews as well as supplier risk and spend data into a single model, making it ideal for regulatory compliance.
Ironclad is optimized for legal operations teams that automate large contract processes by providing code-free workflow design and powerful collaborative editing capabilities.
notable_data_or_quotes: Gatekeeper contract processing speed reduced by 75%
Ironclad has a basic cost of approximately $5,000.
pages.intended_audience: Teams concerned about automating corporate legal, procurement, financial personnel and contract management
pages.content_notes: The text is cut off during the analysis of 2 of the 10 companies (Gatekeeper, Ironclad), so the content is somewhat incomplete.

pages.title: Aston Martin Aramco signs Zscaler as its global cybersecurity partner
pages.what_its_about: Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team has selected Zscaler as its global cybersecurity partner and signed a multi-year contract.
key_points: Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team has adopted Zscaler's Zero Trust Exchange platform to protect key assets including car design, race strategy and track data.
Its core purpose is to quickly and securely transmit more than a terabyte of telemetry data streaming in real time from hundreds of sensors during an F1 race weekend.
The Zscaler branding will be attached to the nose, seatbelts, side mirrors and driver suit of the AMR26 vehicle and will make its debut at the Austrian Grand Prix.
notable_data_or_quotes: Formula One is where the future of enterprise technology gets tested at 300km/h
pages.intended_audience: F1 Business and IT Cybersecurity Industry Insider

pages.title: Brussels held talks with Washington over Anthropic access after Fable 5 ban
pages.what_its_about: When the European Union (EU) was blocked from using Anthropic's cutting-edge AI model due to export control measures by the United States, negotiations were held between the EU and U.S. governments to resolve this issue.
key_points: Due to the US Department of Commerce's export control order, access to Anthropic's cutting-edge models, Fable 5 and Mythos 5, for overseas users (including the EU) was suddenly blocked.
This blocking measure was imposed after a jailbreak vulnerability was discovered, which halted access to major organizations such as the EU Cybersecurity Agency (ENISA) and NATO.

This incident strengthened the perception in Europe that dependence on American technology is a strategic risk, and in countries such as France, calls for the development of independent AI (Mistral, etc.) grew louder.
notable_data_or_quotes: Downing Street pressed the White House for a UK carve-out and was told there was “zero chance,”
pages.intended_audience: AI industry insiders, IT and national security policymakers, and technology journalists

pages.title: Chamath Palihapitiya: Meta “fumbled” its shot at AI
pages.what_its_about: Investor Chamas Palihapitiya evaluates Mehta's failure to dominate the AI ​​market, his rebuttal to the theory that AI will lead to the end of jobs, and his regrets about his SPAC investment.
key_points: They criticized Meta for completely missing and failing to have a huge opportunity to become a leader in the AI ​​market.
Popular fears that AI will eliminate jobs ignore past historical patterns, arguing that new technologies will expand human activity.
It was pointed out that Meta has not been able to properly dominate the American-style open source AI field amid the rise of DeepSeek, a low-cost open-weight model in China.
pages.intended_audience: Public interested in IT business and AI industry trends, and investment trends

pages.title: Netris raises $15M Series A from a16z to help AI neoclouds go live faster
pages.what_its_about: Network automation startup Netris has raised a $15 million Series A investment from a16z to accelerate data center construction and operations for its AI neocloud.
key_points: Netris provides software and a platform that runs on network switches to help AI neocloud operators automate setup, configuration, and operations, and accelerate time-to-market.
This platform provides hardware acceleration-based network abstraction and server/resource isolation for multi-tenancy environments.

It is compatible with Nvidia and AMD servers and various network equipment, and is currently applied to more than 35 GPU clusters (approximately 1 million GPUs) around the world, including Lightning AI and Foxconn.
pages.intended_audience: AI data center and neocloud operator, cloud infrastructure investor, network engineer

pages.title: Adobe acquires image and video enhancement tool maker Topaz Labs
pages.what_its_about: Adobe announced that it has acquired Topaz Labs, a developer of video and image AI quality improvement tools, and will integrate it into its creative business.
key_points: Adobe plans to acquire Topaz Labs to integrate AI models into its image and video editing suite and Firefly AI app.
Topaz Labs is an Emmy Award-winning company and has its own models, including 'Astra' for video upscaling and 'Wonder' for image retouching.
Through this acquisition, Adobe aims to widen the gap with competitors such as Canva and Blackmagic Design and strengthen its creative ecosystem.
notable_data_or_quotes: The transaction is expected to be completed in the second half of 2026.
“Topaz Labs brings deep expertise in optimizing large-scale, complex AI models to run directly on devices, which will enable Adobe to deliver faster, more responsive experiences for our customers.”
pages.intended_audience: IT and creative industry workers, designers, video experts, photographers

pages.title: Amazon ups India bet with fresh $13B AI infrastructure investment
pages.what_its_about: Amazon announced an additional investment of $13 billion to expand its AI and cloud infrastructure in India.
key_points: Additional investment plans were revealed following a meeting between Amazon CEO Andy Jassy and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
The investment will expand Amazon Web Services' (AWS) data center capacity in Mumbai and Hyderabad.
Global technology companies are sparing no investment in India, seeing it as a major hub for the computing infrastructure needed to run AI products.
pages.intended_audience: Investors, IT business analysts and developers interested in IT industry trends and investment flows from global technology companies

pages.title: Ford had to hire back former engineers to fix mistakes made by its automated systems
pages.what_its_about: It is said that Ford rehired retired veteran engineers to solve quality problems that occurred during the introduction of automation systems and AI.
key_points: Ford believed that it would be able to maintain quality by introducing automation and AI, but suffered a decline in quality due to the limitations of the system.
The importance of tacit knowledge and knowledge transfer from veteran engineers who have gained experience through past development cycles has been overlooked.
To solve problems and improve AI training data, we rehired or promoted more than 350 experienced engineers, including retirees.
notable_data_or_quotes: “Mistakenly, we thought that by just introducing artificial intelligence and adjusting the design requirements that we had, that that would produce a high-quality product,”
pages.intended_audience: Automotive industry officials, corporate managers promoting AI adoption and IT innovation, and technical workers

pages.title: Facebook’s Creator Studio has been revived as an AI companion app
pages.what_its_about: Meta has relaunched the existing ‘Creator Studio’ as an AI companion app to help creators grow on Facebook.
key_points: Meta has reorganized and introduced Creator Studio, which was abolished in the past, as an AI-based standalone app.

The core feature, the 'AI Creator Assistant' chatbot, provides performance analysis information, customized engagement improvement suggestions, classification of major comments, and the ability to draft replies tailored to the creator's tone of voice.
We are currently testing it with some creators and accepting pre-applications through a waiting list.
notable_data_or_quotes: exactly what to do next to succeed on Facebook
pages.intended_audience: Creators and marketers who are active on Facebook and want to improve content performance and management

pages.title: Baidu Releases Unlimited OCR, a 3B Model That Keeps the KV Cache Flat for Long-Document Parsing
pages.what_its_about: Baidu has launched a 3B size Unlimited OCR model that solves the problem of slowdown by keeping the KV cache size constant when parsing long documents.
key_points: To solve the problem of slower speed due to larger KV cache as output tokens increase, the decoder's attention is replaced with Reference Sliding Window Attention (R-SWA) to keep memory usage constant.
It has a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) structure with a total of 3 billion (3B) parameters, and only 500M (500M) parameters are activated during inference.
It scored 93.23 points in OmniDocBench v1.5, showing 6.22 points higher performance than the existing DeepSeek OCR baseline.
pages.intended_audience: Artificial intelligence researcher, OCR technology developer, large document analysis and natural language processing engineer

pages.title: 5 Open Source Omni AI Models That Handle Text, Images, Audio, and Video
pages.what_its_about: We introduce and analyze five open source Omni AI models that can integratedly process text, images, audio, and video.
key_points: In the past, multimodality was implemented by combining several individual models, but recently, a single model has developed into a form that integrates and processes various inputs and outputs.

NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 30B A3B is specialized for enterprise document, video, speech analysis and GUI automation with Mamba2-Transformer hybrid MoE architecture and support for 256K token context window.
Google Gemma 4 12B IT is a lightweight multimodal model for local and self-hosted applications that uses an encoder-free architecture to process text, images, audio, video, and respond with text.
notable_data_or_quotes: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni: 31B-parameter Mamba2-Transformer hybrid Mixture-of-Experts architecture (around 3B active parameters per token)
pages.intended_audience: AI application developer, data scientist, enterprise AI system architect

pages.title: The Roadmap to Becoming an AI Architect in 2026
pages.what_its_about: We present a step-by-step roadmap and necessary core competencies for engineers to become AI architects in 2026.
key_points: The role of an AI architect is to go beyond simple coding and design the entire system, deciding on trade-offs such as technology selection, scalability, reliability, risk, and business value creation.
As of 2026, there has been a surge in demand for AI architects who can transform AI prototypes built over the past two years into manageable, cost-effective production systems.

The core competencies required for AI architects are in five areas: technology and data fundamentals, system architecture design, technology selection, scalability and cost, governance, and business alignment.
notable_data_or_quotes: Where an engineer implements components, an architect designs the end-to-end system and owns the tradeoffs
pages.intended_audience: AI engineers, data engineers, data scientists, and technical professionals who want to grow as architects in the AI ​​field.

pages.title: RIFT-Bench: Dynamic Red-teaming For Agentic AI Systems
pages.what_its_about: We propose RIFT-Bench, a dynamic red team methodology based on graph representations for security evaluation of various agent AI systems.
key_points: RIFT-Bench based on hierarchical graph representation was introduced to overcome existing security evaluation limitations dependent on specific implementations or domains.
It operates in two automated phases: a Discovery phase, which extracts system structure, and a Scanning phase, which deploys adaptive adversarial attacks and generates a comprehensive report.
We demonstrate the effectiveness of our evaluation pipeline across 45 different agent systems and its generalizability to heterogeneous agent architectures.
pages.intended_audience: AI security researcher, agent AI system developer, AI evaluation and red team expert

pages.title: Neuro-Symbolic Drive: Rule-Grounded Faithful Reasoning for Driving VLAs
pages.what_its_about: In order to solve the problem of lack of causality between the decision-making reasoning method and planned actions of existing autonomous driving VLA models, this study proposes a 'Neuro-Symbolic Drive' framework that learns driving VLA through symbolic reasoning traces of a rule-based planner.
key_points: Flow of thought (CoT) reasoning in existing autonomous VLAs tends to be causally disconnected from actual planned physical behavior.

The proposed Neuro-Symbolic Drive extracts the inference traces, such as review of actual constraints and trajectory exploration, executed by the classic rule-based planner in the decision-making stage and uses them as learning supervision data.
Significantly improved trajectory error (ADE@3s) and miss rate in simulator benchmark tests by structurally combining the inference process with action generation.
notable_data_or_quotes: In a 3-camera recognition environment, ADE@3s decreased from 0.47 to 0.26, and miss rate decreased from 8.30% to 6.40%.
In an 8-camera recognition environment, ADE@3s decreased from 0.54 to 0.26, and miss rate decreased from 10.13% to 5.99%.
pages.intended_audience: Autonomous driving control model developer and artificial intelligence researcher

pages.title: Critique of Agent Model
pages.what_its_about: Following the proliferation of LLM-based systems, this study analyzes the definition and architecture of true agents and proposes a new general-purpose agent model, the GIC architecture.
key_points: We define the boundaries of true agents by distinguishing between 'agentic' systems that rely on engineered workflows and 'agentive' systems in which autonomy is expressed by internal factors.
We analyze the agent's architecture into five dimensions: goals, identity, decision-making, self-regulation, and learning.

We propose a Goal-Identity-Configurator (GIC) architecture that combines hierarchical goal decomposition, identity evolution, world model-based simulation reasoning, self-regulation, and self-directed learning.
pages.intended_audience: AI researchers, agent system developers, AI safety and control policy makers

pages.title: Can Language Model Agents be Helpful Circuit Explainers in Mechanistic Interpretability?
pages.what_its_about: This study analyzes whether language model (LM) agents can help explain the functions of circuits identified in Mechanistic Interpretability and proposes evaluation benchmarks and frameworks.
key_points: To solve the circuit description problem, we introduce AgenticInterpBench, a benchmark consisting of 84 semi-synthetic transformer circuits and 163 component-level annotations.

We proposed HyVE (Hypothesize, Validate, Explain), an agent-type explainer that analyzes and explains circuits through an iterative loop of observation, hypothesis generation, and causal verification.

As a result of the analysis, we confirmed that a strong language model backbone is good at forming hypotheses based on observations, but failures mainly occur in the verification loop stage, such as incomplete verification plans, code execution errors, and unresolved hypotheses.
pages.intended_audience: Mechanistic interpretability, AI safety, model interpretation, and artificial intelligence agent researchers

pages.title: Ensemble Feature Selection and Harris Hawks Optimization for Explainable Mental Health Risk Prediction in Female Sex Workers
pages.what_its_about: We propose an explainable AI (XAI) prediction model combining ensemble feature selection and Harris Hawks Optimization algorithm to predict mental health risk (depression) in female sex workers (FSWs).
key_points: Based on data from 3,005 female sex workers, we developed a logistic regression hybrid model adjusted by ANOVA and mutual information-based ensemble feature selection and Harris Mae optimization, a swarm intelligence algorithm.
The proposed model showed excellent performance compared to traditional classification techniques (accuracy 95.78%, F1 score 95.77%, AUC 0.96).
Explainable AI (XAI) technology identified post-traumatic stress, violence from clients, and occupational factors as major contributors to depression.
pages.intended_audience: Mental health researchers, social welfare experts, and healthcare-related AI model developers

pages.title: From Meta Idea to Advanced Mathematical Discovery -- Human-AI Co-Discovery of Sign-Embedding Quantum Algorithms
pages.what_its_about: This is a case study of the development of a sign-embedding quantum algorithm for matrix equations and matrix functions through joint exploration between humans and AI.
key_points: AI has contributed to extending vague intuitions in the early stages of research into concrete problems and families of theorems worth proving.
AIM, an agent AI mathematician system, linked known matrix sign identities with a wider range of matrix equations and functions and drafted proofs and complexity calculations.
The final scientific judgment and filtering (e.g., discovery of conditional errors of specific approximations, refinement of Sylvester implementation) was done by human researchers.
pages.intended_audience: Researchers and developers interested in quantum computing, AI-assisted mathematics research, and quantum algorithm development

pages.title: On-Device Neural Architecture Search
pages.what_its_about: For sensor data analysis, we propose a new on-device NAS method that performs lightweight artificial neural network architecture exploration (NAS) directly within the device to find an ultra-small neural network optimized for each user or situation.
key_points: We propose a proximity sensor computing approach that runs a lightweight NAS directly on the deployment device to analyze real-time data acquired from sensors.
Performance was verified on various embedded systems using the Italian Sign Language dataset (ISL) and the Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) fault diagnosis dataset.
When running on Raspberry Pi 4, it consumed much less RAM and showed improved accuracy compared to the existing state-of-the-art technique (SOTA).
notable_data_or_quotes: Based on ISL dataset: RAM usage reduced by 0.63 times, accuracy improved by 5.96% points
Based on CWRU dataset: RAM usage reduced by 0.44 times, accuracy improved by 0.2 percentage points
pages.intended_audience: On-device AI, lightweight neural network design, and embedded sensor computing researchers and developers

pages.title: LLM Evolution as an Industry-Scale Ecosystem: A Lifecycle Perspective on Continual Learning
pages.what_its_about: This study redefines continuous learning of industrial large-scale language models (LLM) from an ecosystem life cycle perspective and proposes five core design principles and an actual deployment roadmap.
key_points: We identified three key challenges in industrial continuous learning (ICL): poor model plasticity due to iterative adaptation, limitations in performance inheritance when upgrading base models, and lack of long-term sustainability.

We present five life cycle design principles: preserving plasticity margin, treating upgrades as function transfers, reliable continuous reinforcement learning, self-optimization of learning recipes, and building accountability as a base layer.
To bridge the gap between academic research and industrial practical application, we assess technological maturity and propose a specific practical deployment blueprint.
pages.intended_audience: Artificial intelligence researchers and developers who design LLM deployment and continuous learning systems in industrial settings

pages.title: A Spectral Phase Diagram for Binary Few-Shot Classification: Intrinsic Dimensionality, Geometric Saturation, and Representational Diagnosis
pages.what_its_about: In order to determine when to stop collecting additional labels in binary few-shot classification, this study proposed and analyzed a saturation index that can be calculated only from the characteristics of the support data.
key_points: To determine when to stop collecting additional labels, we propose a saturation index S(K) that can be calculated without the need for test labels or trained classifiers.
Empirically demonstrates that there is a high correlation between saturation index and marginal accuracy gain
Classification stages are presented in three phase diagrams: exploration, transition, and saturation.
If the accuracy is low even though the saturation index is low, it can be used as a tool to diagnose the inadequacy of the expression space itself.
notable_data_or_quotes: Stage 3 Marginal Gain: Exploration 3.48%, Conversion 2.40%, Saturation 0.82%
AUC = 0.752 achieved as a binary classification stopping rule
Correlation between asymptotic effective dimension and highest accuracy Spearman r_s = 0.380 (p = 0.133)
pages.intended_audience: Machine learning model developer, data annotation planner, AI researcher

pages.title: Supervised Reinforcement Learning for the Coordination of Distributed Energy Resources
pages.what_its_about: For the coordination of distributed energy resources (DER) with uncertainty and complexity, we propose a supervised reinforcement learning (SRL) framework that combines dictionary learning and fine-tuning.
key_points: To solve the sample inefficiency and inappropriate optimization problems of existing reinforcement learning, we propose a supervised reinforcement learning (SRL) framework inspired by the training paradigm of large-scale language models.
After pre-learning the policy using supervised learning on demo data, the policy is advanced through reinforcement learning through two-stage fine tuning, offline and online.

Experimental results show that the reinforcement learning implementation based on the proposed framework significantly outperforms all baseline performances and achieves high cost-effectiveness even on low-quality demo data.
pages.intended_audience: Researchers in the field of power systems and distributed energy resources (DER) management and developers in the field of reinforcement learning applications

pages.title: Graph-Based Phonetic Error Correction of Noisy ASR
pages.what_its_about: We propose G-SPIN, a new framework that combines phoneme graph modeling and contextual language understanding to correct lexical errors in speech recognition (ASR) systems.
key_points: Even though the word error rate is low, the ASR system generates structural errors due to phonemic similarity in semantically important tokens such as proper nouns and negatives.

The proposed G-SPIN framework builds acoustically valid candidates using a graph neural network (GNN) and then performs a final re-ranking that reflects the context using MLM and instruction-tuned LLM.

By separating structured phoneme inference from contextual meaning selection, it avoids unlimited text generation and is designed to operate only at the point of inference in a lightweight, modular manner.
pages.intended_audience: AI researchers and developers in speech recognition and natural language processing technologies

pages.title: Small edits, large models: How Wikipedia advocacy shapes LLM values
pages.what_its_about: This study demonstrated through data attribution analysis the impact of the activities of a small number of advocacy groups editing Wikipedia on animal welfare-related values ​​and answers in a large-scale language model (LLM).
key_points: We analyzed the impact of 125 small edits made by Advocates for Animal Welfare (PAW) on 115 Wikipedia pages on the training data weights and answer propensity of an AI model.
Gradient-based data attribution analysis of the Llama 3.1 8B and Llama 3.2 1B model subjects confirmed that PAW's edits had a very strong impact on animal welfare-related queries.

Models fine-tuned with PAW content significantly reduced perplexity for animal welfare text compared to the control group, improving the model's language understanding performance in specific advocacy directions.
pages.intended_audience: AI researchers, data ethics and policy makers, content managers

pages.title: AgentOdyssey: Open-Ended Long-Horizon Text Game Generation for Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
pages.what_its_about: We introduce AgentOdyssey, a new evaluation framework that procedurally generates open-ended text games to evaluate an agent's ability to learn continuously over testing time.
key_points: AgentOdyssey creates open-ended text games with rich objects, world dynamics, and long-term tasks to assess agents' exploration, knowledge acquisition, episodic memory retention, and long-term planning abilities.

This framework goes beyond traditional test-time non-learning assumptions by placing agents in a persistent, long-term environment where learning and inference interact throughout the deployment process.

Experimental results show that even top-tier agents fall far short of human performance, leaving significant room for improvement, and confirm that short-term memory is a critical component of agents' test-time learning.
pages.intended_audience: Researchers in the field of artificial intelligence agents and continuous learning

pages.title: Error-Aware TF-IDF Retrieval-Augmented Generation for ASR Error Correction
pages.what_its_about: To solve speech recognition (ASR) errors, we propose an efficient retrieval augmented generation (RAG) framework based on a lightweight error-aware TF-IDF and text normalization that reflects historical errors.
key_points: We propose a pure vocabulary-based error recognition RAG framework to solve the problems of high latency or phonetic misrecognition neglect in existing ASR correction systems.

Combining a symmetric text normalization module with a diagonal penalty matrix based on historical error history, we preferentially retrieve proofread documents containing high-risk misidentification words.
Evaluation of the Persian subset of the FLEURS dataset significantly improves search success rate and final word error rate (WER) with little increase in latency
notable_data_or_quotes: Error recognition search success rate (hit rate) improved from 53.7% to 90.9%
Final Word Error Rate (WER) decreased from 23.06% to 18.83%
pages.intended_audience: AI researchers and developers in Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Search Augmented Generation (RAG)

pages.title: Dustin: Draft-Augmented Sparse Verification for Efficient Long-Context Generation with Speculative Decoding
pages.what_its_about: To speed up long context inference in large language models (LLMs), we propose a sparse verification framework 'Dustin' that utilizes information from the draft model and target model.
key_points: We want to solve the Key-Value (KV) cache loading bottleneck that occurs during speculative decoding.
By integrating the draft model's lookahead signal and the target model's past attention, critical tokens are identified with high confidence throughout the multi-step verification window.
Minimize recalculation latency through sparse estimation techniques that limit importance score measurements to only a minimal subset of attention heads.
notable_data_or_quotes: Self-attention speed improved by 27.85 times in Qwen2.5-72B model and 32k sequence length setting.
pages.intended_audience: Artificial intelligence researcher and large language model inference optimization engineer

pages.title: Reid Hoffman: “SpaceX is not an AI company, xAI is a complete mess”
pages.what_its_about: Reid Hoffman strongly criticized SpaceX and xAI for their lack of AI capabilities and departure of founders, and pointed out the fairness issues in the U.S. government's Anthropic model export regulations.
key_points: xAI is in shambles, having lost all 11 of its original co-founders and restarting for the third time by May 2026, and Grok's performance also lags behind its competitors.
SpaceX's acquisition of Cursor and AI infrastructure rental sales only prove its lack of AI capabilities, and it is difficult to view it as an actual AI company.
The fact that the U.S. government has restricted foreign access to Anthropic's Fable and Mythos models, excluding OpenAI, is an asymmetric regulation lacking predictability and principles.

key_points: Wikimedia Foundation employees in the UK sent a letter to management on Wednesday, June 24, requesting recognition of the representation rights of the United Tech and Allied Workers (UTAW).
The background is that employees' concerns about transparency, trust, and the future direction of the organization have increased due to recent rapid changes at WMF.
A petition of support signed by over 1,000 volunteers and community members was submitted, making the UK WMF's largest employer outside the US.
pages.intended_audience: Readership interested in IT and media labor movements, open source/nonprofit operations, and working conditions

pages.title: Anthropic, “Alibaba illegally extracted Claude AI model capabilities”

key_points: Anthropic alleged that Alibaba and its related operators attempted large-scale distillation of its Claude model.
From April 22 to June 5, 2026, more than 28.8 million unusual exchanges occurred through approximately 25,000 fraudulent accounts.

In response to these security concerns, the U.S. Department of Commerce has imposed access restrictions on Anthropic's latest Mythos and Fable AI models, and Anthropic has disabled their operations globally.

pages.title: The Joy and Power of Understanding
pages.what_its_about: This article is about the long-term control and productivity implications of having a deep understanding and fundamentals of technology rather than relying on tools and AI in software development.
key_points: A deep understanding of software allows you to control and own the systems you are responsible for, and the habit of simply copying through an LLM undermines your core competencies.

Core code to be maintained regularly must be written with deeply knowledgeable technology, and it is important to pursue value centered on outcomes (stability, automation, etc.) rather than output (number of lines of code, etc.).

Proficiency in the core technology stack has a compounding effect, accelerating knowledge acquisition and development, so it requires regular effort to read documentation and sources and design your own.
pages.intended_audience: Software developers and technical managers

pages.title: Code as Agent Harness — A 102-page survey that looks at code as the basis for agent execution.
pages.what_its_about: Summary of a survey paper from the perspective of 'code as agent harness', which views code as an execution base for reasoning, behavior, state storage, and feedback verification of Large Language Model (LLM) agents
key_points: Code is defined not as a simple creation result, but as an execution base (Harness) where the agent interacts with the environment and continues execution and verification.
For long-term execution control, mechanisms such as planning, memory as a state management layer, and Plan-Execute-Verify loop are analyzed.
The main cause of agent failure is due to limitations in the harness design, such as insufficient context, weak tool interfaces, and weak verifiers, rather than the model itself.
notable_data_or_quotes: Topological complexity is a tax created by the immaturity of shared state representation.
The cause of failure is not the model but the harness.
pages.intended_audience: Engineers and researchers who study and develop AI agent design and code-based collaboration systems

pages.title: Every Homo naledi we know of is female, and the implications are fascinating
pages.what_its_about: The remains of Homo naledi, an archaic human discovered in South Africa's Rising Star Cave, have all been confirmed to be female, and the resulting research is being analyzed.
key_points: In 2013, a research team led by Lee Berger excavated the remains of about 20 Homo naledi from Rising Star Cave in South Africa.
Protein analysis of tooth enamel showed that all Homo naledi skeletons found in Rising Star Cave were female.
This discovery provides new clues as to how the ancient human remains were placed in the cave, such as whether they were buried simply by accident or intentionally placed.
pages.intended_audience: Public and researchers interested in anthropology, archeology, evolutionary biology and science news

pages.title: What it Means to Be a Mathematician When AI Does the Math
pages.what_its_about: In an era where AI is accelerating the process of mathematical proof and problem solving, it deals with the joy of understanding that mathematicians feel while exploring mathematics and the significance of the existence of human mathematicians.
key_points: In the past, applied mathematics research has advanced enough to be able to solve problems in a matter of days or hours with the help of AI, but pure mathematics requires a process of abstract problem solving and deep understanding.

Mathematicians find the meaning of their studies in the beauty and sense of accomplishment they feel when all the logic comes together after pondering a complex and difficult mathematical problem for a long time.
Modern AI systems are beginning to attempt to bypass and bypass the slow, careful thought processes of mathematicians.
notable_data_or_quotes: “Sometimes, understanding just strikes you as being very beautiful.” —Jeremy Avigad, Carnegie Mellon University
pages.intended_audience: Readership interested in the impact of advances in artificial intelligence on basic science and mathematics and the changing role of human scholars

pages.title: Grab Builds Secure Agentic AI Workload Platform
pages.what_its_about: Grab's cybersecurity and platform engineering teams built Palana, a Kubernetes-native secure execution platform to securely run autonomous AI workloads.
key_points: Apply infrastructure-level isolation and zero trust model to prevent security threats such as prompt injection by autonomous agents and dependency compromise.
Protects your secrets by providing only a placeholder token to the agent container instead of actual credentials, and having the proxy dynamically replace them when making outbound API calls.
Perform operational control outside of the agent runtime, such as executing network kill switches and external reapers through an external control plane.
pages.intended_audience: Platform engineers, cloud architects and cybersecurity experts

key_points: Cloudflare has worked with Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Mozilla Firefox to develop the Private Access Control Tokens (PACT) protocol, which can authenticate human users without CAPTCHA or tracking.
Six vulnerabilities were discovered in curl, including memory lifetime and connection/credential validation logic errors.

In particular, the CVE-2026-8932 vulnerability is a bug that allows previous connections to be reused even after changing mTLS settings, and is the oldest vulnerability that has existed since curl 7.7, which was released on March 22, 2001.

pages.title: Surviving the Mythos Era: Richard Bejtlich on the Case for NDR
pages.what_its_about: We present methods to secure reliable evidence and block attacks when investigating security incidents through network detection and response (NDR).
key_points: Alerts alone are difficult to provide solid evidence needed to investigate security incidents, and in the Mythos era where vulnerability discovery is accelerating, existing workflows are difficult to handle.

Security programs must move away from prevention-oriented security and shift to a focus on 'interdiction', which blocks and neutralizes attacks after an intrusion but before the final goal is achieved.
Threat hunting should be conducted by creating hypotheses about attack techniques and verifying them through network logs and session queries rather than relying on warnings.
notable_data_or_quotes: Richard Bejtlich's NDR Essentials: A Practical Guide to Network Detection and Response
pages.intended_audience: SecOps team member, threat hunter, network security administrator

pages.title: New Gaslight macOS Malware Uses Prompt Injection to Disrupt AI-Assisted Analysis
pages.what_its_about: Analysis of Gaslight, a new macOS malware that attempts to disrupt and bypass AI-based analysis tools using prompt injection.
key_points: Gaslight, a new macOS malware believed to be the work of a North Korea-linked threat actor, has been discovered and contains a prompt injection payload that tricks analysts' AI tools into abandoning their analysis.
The malware performs command and control through the Telegram bot API and supports persistent permission acquisition, file upload, and command execution.
It embeds a Base64-encoded Python script for information gathering, stealing browser data, keychain data, snapshots of running processes, etc.
notable_data_or_quotes: SentinelOne researcher Phil Stokes: "Its most notable feature is an embedded cascade of fabricated system-failure messages, designed to make an LLM-assisted triage agent doubt its own session."
pages.intended_audience: Security analyst, malware researcher, AI security tool developer

pages.title: New Mistic Backdoor Linked to KongTuke in ClickFix and ModeloRAT Campaigns
pages.what_its_about: 'Mistic', a new backdoor that operates quietly and is associated with the KongTuke threat group, is being distributed to multiple organizations.
key_points: Starting in April 2026, the Mistic (MLTBackdoor) backdoor has been distributed to organizations in various fields such as insurance, education, and IT.
Mistic executes payloads from memory without writing files to disk and has a self-destruct function (kill switch) to attempt a long-term and stealthy approach.
Attackers are spreading malware through ClickFix campaigns, including traffic distribution systems (TDS) based on infected WordPress sites and Microsoft Teams messages from fake IT support accounts.
notable_data_or_quotes: The backdoor runs payloads in memory with no file written to disk and includes a kill switch that lets it delete itself, which are features consistent with an operator seeking long-term, low-visibility access
The targeting appears to be opportunistic, with the attackers casting a wide net and then assessing which organizations they could sell access to rather than focusing on a single sector
pages.intended_audience: Cybersecurity Analysts, IT Security Officers, and Enterprise Threat Intelligence Gatherers

pages.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Zero-Day CVE-2026-20245 Exploited to Gain Root Access
pages.what_its_about: An attack case was discovered where a threat actor exploited a zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-20245) in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN to obtain root privileges and erase their traces.
key_points: Attackers have been exploiting a zero-day vulnerability in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN, CVE-2026-20245, for at least two months prior to its official disclosure, elevating the communications service provider's administrator account to root privileges.
Threat actors consistently used anti-forensic techniques, including deleting and recovering modified system configuration files, to avoid detection.
The initial intrusion likely used previously leaked certificates, gained root privileges through a malicious CSV file upload (evil_tenant.csv), and created a user account named troot.
notable_data_or_quotes: "The attacker then changed default admin credentials before exploiting CVE-2026-20245 as a zero-day via a malicious CSV file upload (evil_tenant.csv)," Mandiant said. "This exploit allowed them to escalate privileges and create a rogue user account (named 'troot') with full root-level shell control."
pages.intended_audience: Security analysts, network administrators, and IT security personnel

pages.title: Antropic “Alibaba conducted unauthorized Claude learning with 25,000 fake accounts”
pages.what_its_about: Antropic reported to the U.S. Congress that Alibaba had carried out a distillation attack using approximately 25,000 fake accounts to steal Claude Model's core capabilities without permission.
key_points: Antropic claimed that Alibaba-linked operators attempted to replicate Claude's core capabilities by interacting with him approximately 28.8 million times through fake accounts from April to June.
The core capabilities that Alibaba was targeting were software engineering and agentic reasoning capabilities with high commercial value.
This incident goes beyond a simple corporate dispute and shows a new security threat of behavioral data leakage through API amid the competition for AI hegemony between the US and China.

pages.title: Google engineer: “GLM-5.2 goes to Mithos level without distillation of US model”
pages.what_its_about: Analysis has shown that China's Z.ai's open source model GLM-5.2 can reach the level of coding performance of the latest American model through self-reinforcement learning without knowledge distillation of the American model.
key_points: GLM-5.2 recorded 74.4% in the coding benchmark Frontier SWE, ahead of GPT-5.5 and close to Claude Opus 4.8.

Google engineer Patrick Toulme analyzed that distillation technology is just a tool to create the initial success trajectory of reinforcement learning, and that in the future, reinforcement learning alone can develop to the highest level of performance without distillation.
By applying Unsloss' quantization technology, local operation costs were lowered by significantly reducing model capacity while maintaining accuracy.
notable_data_or_quotes: “Now the Chinese model can reach higher performance without distilling the American model.”
“Reaching Opus 4.8 level from scratch is more difficult than moving up from Opus 4.8 to Fable or Mythos level.”
“GLM-5.2 is already on a successful trajectory, and will continue to rise to the Mythos level with reinforcement learning alone, without any further distillation.”
pages.intended_audience: AI developers, IT industry workers, technical researchers interested in open source LLM and coding agents
